info.name: Khatma BE - Users
info.description: Current-user profile read and display-name update. Authenticated requests use the access token from the Auth collection. Protected routes return 401 without a valid bearer token; invalid display names return 400.

item.name: Read current profile
item.description: Returns { id, email, displayName } for the authenticated user. A missing user returns 404.

item.name: Update current display name
item.description: Updates only the authenticated user's display name. The trimmed value must contain 1 to 80 characters; invalid input returns 400. Returns { id, email, displayName }.
